invariants.rationale: HoodieListData.eager returns a HoodieData<T> and likely never returns null.
HoodieListData.eager likely wraps 'data', so collecting the list gives back the original.
The number of items in the returned HoodieData should match the size of the input list.
If the input data is empty, the resulting HoodieData should also be empty (and vice versa).
If the input data is empty, the result must also be empty.
